releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.2.0 (CamScanner-Grade Full Pro Suite)
changelog:
🚀 Flagship Master Release v10.2.0:
• In-Place Text Editor Pro: Exact stroke contrast Serif/Sans font classifier, 5x5 zero-halo inpainting, and true chromatic ink autofetch.
• Govt Exam Batch Studio: Strict 20/50/100KB target resizing, authentic JFIF & Exif 200/300 DPI metadata injection, CR80 duplex ID alignment, and UIDAI legal Aadhaar/PAN auto-redaction.
• Real Office OpenXML Export: Fully editable PowerPoint text shapes (<p:sp>), structured Word tables, and typed Excel cells.
• Official Signature & Rubber Stamp Studio: LAB color vector ink extraction with notebook ruled-line suppression, circular double-ring seals with arc text, and legal PKI X.509 cryptographic PDF signing.
• On-Device Local AI CountCam: Offline Euclidean Distance Transform peak segmentation separating touching pipes/rebar/pills/coins with zero cloud API keys needed.
• Master UI Overhaul: Clean 2x2 grid quick-hubs where all tools are 100% visible at one glance with zero hidden scrolling.
